raw_segments.text: The grounds upon which Linneus would fain have banished the whales from the waters,
On account of their warm bilocular heart, their lungs, their movable eyelids, their
hollow ears, penim entrantum feminam mamis lactantum, and finally, ex-lege naturae germeritoke.
I submitted all this to my friends Simeon Macy and Charlie Coffin, of Nantucket, both
messmates of mine in a certain voyage, and they united in the opinion that the reasons
Charlie profanely hinted they were humbug.
